data.title: FullWell Launches First-of-Its-Kind Study to Answer a Longstanding Folate Question and Advance the Future of Women's Health Research
data.description: A significant study with approval from the IRB is set to compare methylfolate and folic acid directly. The research will closely monitor biological indicators and real-world reproductive results. Taking place in Boston and initiated by FullWell, a reputable brand that specializes in evidence-based products for reproductive health. This study is scheduled to commence on September 15, 2026, aiming to provide valuable insights into the effectiveness of methylfolate versus folic acid. Stay tuned as the study unfolds and produces critical data on reproductive outcomes.

data.title: NEW JAMA NETWORK OPEN STUDY SHOWS GIVING LESS IV FLUIDS DURING SURGERY CAN BE BENEFICIAL FOR PATIENTS
data.description: In a recent study published in JAMA Network Open, anesthesiologists at Montefiore Einstein conducted a large-scale natural experiment in response to a nationwide shortage of IV fluids. The study, based in The Bronx, N.Y., yielded significant findings, highlighting the impact of reducing IV fluid usage during the shortage. This research is crucial as it provides valuable insights into managing IV fluid shortages efficiently and ensuring patient care quality during such circumstances.
